heroHeadline: Turkey Condemns Houthi Drone Attack on Saudi Arabia, Backing Pact Alignment
heroSubtitle: Turkey's defence ministry publicly condemned a Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia, signaling alignment with the Saudi-led coalition as pact members face mounting pressure to escalate their response. France's bilateral troop deployment to protect Yanbu remains the first concrete foreign reinforcement, while Turkey and Pakistan continue to signal growing cohesion within the Mecca Pact framework.
